name: Red Earth — Gate 2 Starter Shiny FX
author: Adam M. Aguilera
description: Player-side Gen 2 shiny sparkle and sound for Red Earth guaranteed-shiny Fennekin/Grass starters only. Uses the same gold-with-lilac accent presentation already approved for Gate 2; does not change shiny state, starter routing, art, scale, evolution, Irregular Pokémon, Nature or passives.
